Elena (Product): quick follow-up from today's all-hands 55 folks want a compact timeline for Console batching controls, API billing tiers, and Optimize suggestions. can we publish a one-pager for sales/marketing today?

Noah (Eng): short commits: Console batching internal canary 2024-06-26; partner beta early July; public GA late July pending certification. API tiers beta 2024-07-29, GA mid-August. Optimize read-only suggestions 2024-06-30; write-mode early Sept.

Maya (Ops): note: Dedicated customers need an SLA addendum before GA. ops needs ~2 weeks after eng signoff to certify.

Ravi (Legal): send proposed tier terms by July 1 and we'll return redline by July 10. also need data-use wording for Optimize.

Lina (Marketing): I can prepare an FAQ + one-slide TL;DR once dates are locked. prefer "late-June internal canary; early-July partner beta; late-July public rollout" phrasing.

Ari (Sales): sales asks: migration playbook, AE script, and clear opt-out instructions for enterprise calls.

Noah (Eng): opt-out example (admin only): PUT /v1/tenant/features {"smart_batching": false}. We'll emit telemetry: batching ratio, p50/p95 token latency.

Elena (Product): action items: (1) publish single-page timeline (owner: Elena) today, (2) migration playbook (owner: Ari) by July 3, (3) legal terms draft (owner: Ravi) by July 1, (4) docs PR for opt-out + telemetry (owner: Maya) by June 25. I'll post the doc to #all-hands and #customer-comm and pin it.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled: runtime v1.9 -> us-west on 2024-06-26T03:00:00Z.

Elena (Product): thanks everyone 55 will reconvene next week to confirm final comms.
